title: AD Smoke Test Checklist
diff_no_previous: No earlier build of this kind
section_diff: What changed since the previous build
diff_hint: The latest build of the selected test type is pre-selected and compared with the one before it. You can change either dropdown.
diff_undescribed: more automated or undescribed changes also touched this area
diff_truncated: Large diff: some changes were classified by title only.
field_diff_notes: Notes on the changes (optional — included on the Confluence page)
diff_notes_placeholder: Anything to call out for this build?
diff_total_line: {n} on the truck since the previous build
simple_hmi_none: Nothing changed on the driver's screen or in the sounds it makes.
simple_hmi_some: {n} to what the driver sees and hears on the screen.
simple_behavior_none: The truck makes the same driving decisions as before.
simple_behavior_some: {n} to how the truck decides what to do — like when to slow down, stop or change lanes.
simple_planner_none: No changes to how the truck plans where to drive and how fast.
simple_planner_some: {n} to how the truck plans where to drive and how fast.
simple_prediction_none: No changes to how the truck guesses what other cars and people will do.
simple_prediction_some: {n} to how the truck guesses what other cars and people will do next.
simple_fixes_none: No bug fixes on the truck tonight.
simple_fixes_some: {n}: problems that were found and repaired, or changes that were undone.
simple_undescribed: {u} more are small automatic updates without a description (hard to spot).
simple_undescribed_one: 1 more is a small automatic update without a description (hard to spot).
simple_other: {n} on the truck that don't affect these areas
simple_other_auto: {m} of them are automatic system updates
simple_other_auto_one: 1 of them is an automatic system update
impact_ignored: {n} tools, simulation and test changes are not shown — they don't run on the truck.
impact_internal: on the truck, hard to spot
behavior_visible: You'll see it on the driver's screen
note_visible_prefix: On the driver's screen or in the sounds it makes.
note_speedup: Efficiency change: the truck is meant to drive exactly the same, just with less computing delay. A driving difference here would be worth reporting.
note_refactor: Code tidy-up: no change to how the truck drives is intended.
note_tuning: Settings adjusted: the truck may react a little differently (earlier or later, harder or softer) in the situations this covers.
note_fix: A problem was fixed: the truck should now do the right thing where it previously misbehaved.
note_revert: An earlier change was undone: driving goes back to how it was before that change.
note_new: New behavior: expect the truck to do something it did not do before in the situations this covers.
note_removal: Something was removed or switched off: the truck will no longer do this.
note_other: This changes how the truck drives; read the description to see how.
flag_no_description: No description — ask the author what this changes before testing.
flag_undescribed_driving_one: 1 automatic update touched driving or driver-facing code with no description — worth asking about before testing.
flag_undescribed_driving: {u} automatic updates touched driving or driver-facing code with no description — worth asking about before testing.
flag_no_pr: no pull request (copied in from the main repository
impact_s_visible_one: is easy to spot on the truck
impact_s_visible: are easy to spot on the truck
impact_s_internal_one: runs on the truck but is hard to spot
impact_s_internal: run on the truck but are hard to spot
cat_hmi_desc: what the driver sees and hears
cat_behavior_desc: driving decisions: yielding, lane changes, stops
cat_prediction_desc: predicting what other road users will do
feedback_intro: Ask a question, report a bug, or suggest an improvement. Your message is emailed to the checklist owner from your own Google account. Japanese messages are automatically translated to English for the recipient.
feedback_message_placeholder: What happened? What did you expect? Steps to reproduce, run IDs, links…
feedback_translated_note: (Automatically translated to English for the recipient.)
feedback_need_connect: One-time step: connect Gmail below, then press Send again.
feedback_connect_explain: To send the email from your own account, allow this app to send mail on your behalf (send-only permission, one time).
feedback_connecting: Finish the Google consent in the popup…
feedback_popup_blocked: Your browser blocked the popup. Allow popups for this site and try again.
feedback_error: Could not send. Please email the owner directly:
